## Verse 1

The road was long and the night came down
I carried my shoes through the sleeping town
Nobody knew me and nobody cared

## Chorus

Take me home, take me home
Where the porch light burns
Take me home

## Verse 2

The river was wide and the bridge was gone
I sang to myself until the dawn
Somebody called and I was there

## Chorus

Take me home, take me home
Where the porch light glows
Take me home
